questions: Which information families add predictive value beyond personal frequency?
Do broader co-occurrence or cross-order associations help, including where rules cover the targets?
How much of the long-history difficulty is associated with candidate and target-set size?
primary_metric: macro recall among users with nonempty repeat targets
selection: maximum validation recall averaged over training seeds; no confirmation feedback
primary_interval: paired user bootstrap; 95% marginal and Bonferroni simultaneous percentile intervals over 8 contrasts
rule_primary_scope: cross-product rules only; exclude self transitions; fit on train prior only
rule_diagnostics: covered-target Recall@10 with original full candidate rankings, and user coverage strata; exploratory

history_diagnostics.interpretation: standardization is descriptive; within-user counting-window comparison keeps the full historical candidate set fixed and is not a new-user simulation

stop_rule: complete every declared comparison, independent audits, evidence-backed writeup and demo; no requirement that hypotheses be positive
